# Trusted Properties

> Bengaluru property information and enquiry website covering 18 properties from SOBHA, Puravankara, Provident and DNR Group.

Trusted Properties is an independent multi-developer platform, not an official developer website. All prices and completion dates are indicative information from the linked project sources, not live quotations or verified inventory. Visuals are illustrative.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.trustedproperties.net/): Overview, imagery and enquiry form.
- [All Bengaluru properties](https://www.trustedproperties.net/properties/): Compare every listed project.
- [Rental properties](https://www.trustedproperties.net/rental/): Rental listings are coming soon.
- [Property FAQs](https://www.trustedproperties.net/faqs/): Pricing, configurations, plots, timelines and property enquiry information.
- [Property films](https://www.trustedproperties.net/films/): Eight supplied reference videos.

## Bangalore search guides

- [Bangalore property guide](https://www.trustedproperties.net/bangalore/): Find Bangalore homes and plots with Trusted Properties. Compare localities, explore developer projects and use practical guides for buying or renting.
- [Bangalore rental guide](https://www.trustedproperties.net/properties-for-rent-in-bangalore/): Planning to rent in Bangalore? Compare localities, BHK sizes, furnishing, monthly costs and viewing checks. A practical guide, without live rental listings.
- [Whitefield properties](https://www.trustedproperties.net/properties-in-whitefield/): Compare SOBHA One World and Provident Botanico around Whitefield, Bangalore. Explore sourced configurations, locations, guide prices and project details.
- [Sarjapur Road and nearby properties](https://www.trustedproperties.net/properties-in-sarjapur-road/): Explore SOBHA Altair off Sarjapura Road and nearby Panathur and Bellandur projects. Compare each Bangalore address, configuration and sourced project guide.
- [North Bangalore properties](https://www.trustedproperties.net/properties-in-north-bangalore/): Compare North Bangalore apartments, villaments and plots at Purva Atmosphere, Provident Ecopolitan, Deansgate and SOBHA Chartered Birdsong.
- [HSR Layout properties](https://www.trustedproperties.net/properties-in-hsr-layout/): Compare SOBHA Infinia and Purva Meraki in HSR Layout, Bangalore. Explore 3 and 4 BHK guide configurations, project locations and indicative purchase prices.
- [Residential plots in Bangalore](https://www.trustedproperties.net/residential-plots-in-bangalore/): Compare SOBHA Sacred Grove at Chikka Tirupati and Chartered Birdsong off Rajanakunte. Review sourced plot sizes, locations and indicative per-square-foot rates.
- [Bangalore home buying checklist](https://www.trustedproperties.net/guides/bangalore-property-buying-checklist/): Prepare for a Bangalore property purchase: compare exact addresses, floor plans, itemised costs, project phases, source documents and questions for site visits.

The separate rental planning guide provides general search advice; Trusted Properties does not publish live rental inventory yet. The enquiry form is for purchase projects.

## Source and text versions

- [Source project guide](https://www.trustedproperties.net/project-guide.pdf): Supplied SOBHA reference; current details must be confirmed.
- [Full text collection](https://www.trustedproperties.net/llms-full.txt): Project facts and FAQ answers in one file.
- [Project data](https://www.trustedproperties.net/data/projects.json): Machine-readable facts and canonical links.
- [Home in Markdown](https://www.trustedproperties.net/index.md): Text version of the overview.
- [Privacy notice](https://www.trustedproperties.net/privacy/): Form data and contact consent.

Project pages also have Markdown versions at their canonical directory URL followed by index.md. These text versions describe the same facts available to visitors.
